Title: I Resigned from Anthropic Today
Article title: Jacob Coxon (@hilbertspaess): "I resigned from Anthropic today. I spent the last three years doing pretraining research at both OpenAI and Anthropic. Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives. More thoughts below."
